input.document_text: Warranty Claim Notice. Unit: Hitachi 2 Ton Inverter Split AC (Model RSOG324HEEA). Customer: Prakash Nair, Commercial Property, Kochi. Purchase Date: 2024-05-28. Warranty: 2 years standard. Warranty Expiry: 2026-05-28. Claim Date: 2026-03-14. Days Until Warranty Lapses: 75. Problem: Outdoor unit making grinding noise during operation. Vibration level significantly increased over past 2 weeks. Engineer Diagnosis: Fan motor bearing failure. If not repaired, compressor damage likely within days. Immediate replacement required.
